plan.problem: Current operations assume Working Copy for all work and do not define full off-GitHub recovery; LAB docs incorrectly call a public staging institute private.

plan.design: Documentation and ignore only, informed by both current snapshots, rulesets, Actions, lifecycle and tool source. All backup/test artifacts stay outside the repository; missing local/administrative evidence remains unverified.
alternativesRejected: New backup daemon/dashboard/audit framework: unnecessary for current individual operations
Bulk repository synchronization, Engine migration or Production ruleset edits: outside authorization and unrelated risk
A separate duplicate tool manual: integrate into existing OPERATIONS
plan.migration: No runtime/data/URL/save migration. Preserve existing Desk workflow, only qualify it as local work and add safe cloud-to-local handoff.
plan.compatibility: All works, frozen archives, LAB generated assets, shared Engines, runtime and CI definitions retain exact base blobs. Ignore does not remove tracked files or replace diff review.
